title: Meritop
tagline: Automatización on-chain de recompensas para marcas y creadores con smart wallets.
description:
Meritop is an on-chain reward automation platform that connects brands with creators and transparently distributes campaign rewards based on performance metrics such as engagement, views, or sign-ups.

Brands create a wallet, launch a reward pool, set campaign goals, and track creator submissions. Creators connect their wallet, upload their social profile data, join campaigns, and submit their work.

Smart contracts automatically evaluate results and distribute payments to top-performing creators, removing intermediaries, increasing transparency, and enabling trustless payouts across Web3 ecosystems.
how_its_made:
MERITOP is built using Polygon for fast, low-cost transactions and Privy for secure embedded wallet creation and authentication. Users complete an onboarding flow that generates their wallet and profile—brand or creator—using Privy’s API.
Campaigns, reward rules, and participation data are stored via Base44’s backend functions. The smart-contract layer handles reward pool creation and automated distribution based on campaign metrics.
ENS can be optionally used to provide human-readable identity for brands and creators. The frontend was built in a no-code/vibecoding environment using Base44’s UI builder, while backend logic connects the app with blockchain interactions and automated ranking calculations.
The system demonstrates how brands can run trustless creator campaigns with transparent on-chain payouts.
